issues.legal_issue: A court’s express determination of a matter at an earlier stage of the same proceeding binds the parties at later stages when it is not merely interlocutory and has not been successfully challenged.
material_facts: In the proceeding to set aside the ex parte eviction order, the court accepted the tenant’s unrebutted evidence that the landlord had agreed to withdraw the eviction petition and had received rent directly from the tenant.
The landlord had contested the tenant’s account but did not enter the witness box, and the court expressly found that the landlord had agreed to withdraw the petition and receive rent.
The eviction petition was later allowed to proceed on the ground of rent arrears, and the earlier finding was not set aside on appeal.
issues.conclusion: The earlier finding bound the landlord at the later stage of the same proceeding. The eviction petition should therefore be dismissed; the appeal was allowed and the judgments below were set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under the principle of res judicata between stages of the same litigation, a matter decided at an earlier stage cannot ordinarily be re-agitated at a later stage. As stated in Satyadhyan Ghosal v. Deorajin Debi, this principle applies where a court has already decided a matter in one way in the same proceeding. It does not prevent reconsideration of interlocutory orders that do not finally determine the parties’ rights, and an earlier decision may be reviewed by an appellate authority in an appeal against the final judgment. Here, the express finding in the proceeding to set aside the ex parte order was binding because it determined the disputed matter and was not successfully challenged.

predicates.same_proceeding: The parties are at a later stage of the same proceeding in which the earlier determination was made.
predicates.earlier_court_expressly_determined_dispu: A court expressly decided a disputed matter at an earlier stage of the proceeding.
predicates.determination_was_not_merely_interlocuto: The earlier determination finally resolved the disputed matter rather than addressing a matter that did not purport to decide the parties’ rights.
predicates.determination_was_not_successfully_chall: The earlier determination was not set aside or otherwise successfully challenged through an available appeal or review.
predicates.earlier_determination_binds_parties_at_l: The parties cannot re-agitate the matter decided by the earlier determination at a later stage of the same proceeding.

issues.definition: When a court expressly resolves a disputed matter in the same proceeding, and that determination is neither merely interlocutory nor successfully challenged, the parties are bound by it at a later stage.
